mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 31 degrees down at Harriet Park, illuminated by a full moon.

Please note that City of Verona buildings will be closed on Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27, for the Thanksgiving holiday. As a result, refuse and recycling collection will be delayed until Friday, November 27, and the recycling center will be closed those two days.
Looking at the calendar, we currently have no upcoming local events scheduled for the next 30 days.
On November 3, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Prairie Way Boulevard where a 31-year-old man was arrested for intimidation of a victim and disorderly conduct.
Today's featured flavor is the classic Butter Pecan. If you are planning a visit, please keep in mind that the store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
